docs.description: On when present. The server's word: adding or removing the attribute wins over a local edit, identical markup keeps it; the live state is the checked property.
Visible label next to the switch.
Server-confirmed value: :state(pending) while the local value differs from the server's value attribute (see revert()).

Revision of the server's value, for commands: the server bumps it with every command it answers for this field, applied or refused. A new rev makes the checked attribute win (present or not) even when it is unchanged, so a refused edit reverts.
The page's word that a command is on its way (e.g. data-attr:pending="$_saving"): :state(pending) and aria-busy while present. It adds to confirm's pending, never clears it.
Name reported in sb-change (e.g. the field of a command).

events.name: change
events.description: After the user flips the switch.

events.name: sb-change
events.description: Same moment. detail: { name, value, checked } (value is the checked state): ready for a command.
